# RELEASE


## DETAILS


## Uniti Group Inc. to Present at the Citi 2026 Global TMT Conference


August 25, 2026


[PDF Version](https://investor.uniti.com/node/16716/pdf)


LITTLE ROCK, Ark., Aug. 25, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Uniti Group Inc. (“Uniti”) (Nasdaq: UNIT) announced today that its President and Chief Executive Officer, Kenny Gunderman, is scheduled to present at the Citi 2026 Global TMT Conference. The presentation is scheduled for 9:30 AM EDT on September 8, 2026 in New York, NY.


You may access a live webcast of the event on Uniti’s Investor Relations website at[investor.uniti.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=KUoBUPLq0-RL-UkMAnufQz-PEV2X3XDAcK2WzS-_SIv8DCY_n9cctXrj2m6bQQ8P7xZBnaSpmtU0uzaMKRNP_ZDAZUssHdvRiYrxl33co6c=) . The webcast will be available for replay for a limited time following the presentation.


**ABOUT UNITI**


Uniti (Nasdaq: UNIT) is a premier insurgent fiber provider dedicated to enabling mission-critical connectivity across the United States. We build, operate, and deliver fast and reliable communications services, empowering more than a million consumers and businesses in the digital economy. Our broad portfolio of services is offered through a suite of brands: Uniti Wholesale, Kinetic, Uniti Fiber, and Uniti Solutions. Visit us online at[www.uniti.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=md1HeB224GS7uH77SA0bHEELFeTMiNwrswOde0MNO9-Nors6UixNqeSd8xvV6C8_tljw4qFP61857iUpzyxV0w==) .
